A LITTLE CELEBRATION OF YOU

Happy Birthday,
Anjali! 🎂

To my sister, my safe place, and my forever favourite 💙

Happy Birthday to the most wonderful sister! 💙 Today is all about celebrating you and the beautiful person you are. You bring so much warmth, laughter, kindness, and happiness into the lives of the people lucky enough to know you. Thank you for being more than a sister—you’re a friend, a supporter, a partner in silly moments, and someone who makes ordinary days feel special. I hope this new year of your life brings you countless reasons to smile, exciting opportunities, peaceful days, unforgettable memories, and people who appreciate your heart as much as you deserve. Never forget how special you are. Your kindness matters, your dreams matter, and your happiness matters. Keep being your lovely, strong, funny, and unique self. Even when life gets confusing or difficult, I hope you always remember that you have someone cheering for you and wishing the very best for you. May every little wish in your heart find its way toward becoming real, and may this year be filled with love, confidence, growth, and beautiful surprises. Thank you for being my sister and for making our bond something I’ll always treasure. I’m proud of you, I’m grateful for you, and I hope your birthday feels as lovely and special as you make other people feel. Here’s to more laughter, more memories, more adventures, and a lifetime of sisterhood. Love you so much, Anjali. Happy Birthday! 🎂💐

Forever your sister • Forever in your corner
